acceptance.routes: Every baseline file and redirect rule accounted for; keep content, alias, export, search and hidden counts distinct.
acceptance.content: Every document preserves visible text, code, heading anchors, navigation information and page-specific UI; no wholesale generated HTML source for docker.
acceptance.metadata: Compare titles, all meta tags, canonical/alternate declarations, structured data and Git-derived dates over the complete corpus.
acceptance.assets: All local URLs resolve at least as well as baseline; copied binary/static assets byte-identical unless equivalence is demonstrated.
acceptance.exports: Markdown, LLM, sitemap, RSS, metadata, robots and verification files remain synchronized with source changes.
acceptance.interaction: Repeat controls.json and authoritative behavior.json.gz checks; compare semantic states and clipboard contents. Search counts can vary while results load; compare settled query results/order/content.
acceptance.visual: Compare every representative state against frozen images, additionally scroll to below-fold interactive regions. Investigate meaningful differences, not screenshot hash equality across platforms.
acceptance.dependency: Incremental output equals fresh full output after page, layout, navigation, global metadata, export/search and URL/redirect changes.

remote_boundary: No telemetry, feedback or AI prompts sent. Consent, analytics, YouTube and legacy Redoc remote scripts inert in captures; preserve integration URLs and local UI. Service responses need deterministic mocks, not live availability claims.
known_harness_limits: browser-v2 search result wait was premature; behavior.json.gz supersedes those detailed checks.
browser-v2 externalRequests contains last context only; controls and API supplement retain blocked request evidence.
Viewport screenshots are initial view; DOM snapshots and focused controls establish behavior beyond that view.
inherited_issues: audit/summary.json and issues.json.gz are observations, not migration failures. Navigation-only metadata records have empty URLs; legacy Redoc creates some anchors at runtime. Do not silently repair or treat all audit observations as true broken publication.
